# Test-only dependencies for .github/workflows/tests.yml. Production code has
# no requirements file and imports PIL lazily; these exist because a handful of
# test modules import Pillow, pytest, or numpy at module level.
#
# Pinned rather than latest so a release on PyPI cannot turn every PR in this
# repository red without a single code change here -- the same standing risk
# PR #109 removed for the vendored substance-tools branch. The versions below
# are the newest that support the workflow's Python 3.10; bump them
# deliberately, in a commit whose CI run is the verification.
pillow==12.3.0
pytest==9.1.1
numpy==2.2.6
